code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    nonzero = [v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0]
    background = max(set(nonzero), key=nonzero.count)
    zeros = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 0]
    motif = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != 0 and v != background]
    zr0, zr1 = min(r for r, c in zeros), max(r for r, c in zeros)
    zc0, zc1 = min(c for r, c in zeros), max(c for r, c in zeros)
    mr0, mr1 = min(r for r, c in motif), max(r for r, c in motif)
    mc0, mc1 = min(c for r, c in motif), max(c for r, c in motif)
    for dr in range(zr1 - zr0 + 1):
        for dc in range(zc1 - zc0 + 1):
            out[zr0 + dr][zc0 + dc] = grid[mr0 + dr][mc1 - dc]
    return out
'''
